title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Exodus 29: the consecration of Aaron and his sons, the offerings, and the daily lambs.

questions.text: Which animals were to be taken to make Aaron and his sons holy?
questions.explanation: Moses was to take one young bull and two rams without defect.

answers.text: One young bull and two rams
Two lambs and a goat
Seven bulls
A heifer and two doves

questions.text: Where was the anointing oil poured on Aaron?
questions.explanation: Moses was to take the anointing oil, pour it on Aaron's head and anoint him.

answers.text: On his feet
On his hands
On his breastplate
On his head

questions.text: Where were the meat, skin and dung of the bull to be burned?
questions.explanation: The meat, skin and dung of the bull were to be burned with fire outside of the camp. It was a sin offering.

answers.text: On the altar
Outside of the camp
In the most holy place
At the gate of the court

questions.text: What was to be done with "the one ram" after it was killed and cut into pieces?
questions.explanation: After the ram was killed and cut into pieces, the whole ram was to be burned on the altar as a burnt offering to Yahweh, a pleasant aroma.

answers.text: Aaron and his sons ate it
It was sent into the wilderness
It was burned whole on the altar
It was given to the people

questions.text: Where was some blood of the second ram put, besides the right thumb and the right big toe?
questions.explanation: The blood was put on the tip of the right ear of Aaron and his sons, on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot.

answers.text: On the middle of the forehead
On the tip of the right ear
On the tip of the left ear
On the lips and the tongue

questions.text: Where were Aaron and his sons to eat the meat of the ram and the bread from the basket?
questions.explanation: Aaron and his sons were to eat the meat of the ram and the bread in the basket at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: At the door of the Tent of Meeting
In their own tents
In the most holy place
By the basin in the court

questions.text: What was to happen to consecration meat or bread left until the morning?
questions.explanation: Anything left until the morning was to be burned with fire and not eaten, because it was holy.

answers.text: It was given to the poor
The Levites were to eat it
It was to be burned with fire
It was kept for the next day

questions.text: For how many days were Aaron and his sons to be consecrated?
questions.explanation: God told Moses: "You shall consecrate them seven days."

answers.text: Three days
Forty days
Twelve days
Seven days

questions.text: When were the two lambs to be offered each day?
questions.explanation: Two lambs a year old were to be offered day by day: one in the morning and the other at evening.

answers.text: Both together at noon each day
One in the morning and one at evening
Both of them at sunrise each day
One on the Sabbath and one at the new moon

questions.text: According to verse 46, why did Yahweh bring Israel out of the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he brought them out of the land of Egypt that he might dwell among them.

answers.text: That they might build him a city
That they might become rich
That they might rule over Egypt
That he might dwell among them
